outcome: Rate of mothers giving birth alone
Rate of mother and newborn skin-to-skin contact
Rate of breastfeeding within 2 hours of birth
cohort: Women admitted to a referral center delivery ward during the 2020 lockdown compared to women admitted during the same period in 2019
finding: Despite differences in labor management and childbirth experiences, no significant differences in maternal or neonatal outcomes were found between women who gave birth during the 2020 lockdown compared to the same period in 2019.
mod_finding: Despite differences in antenatal care and labor induction rates during the COVID-19 pandemic, there was no difference in the mode of delivery between 2019 and 2020.
